topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't believe you're actually telling me this, like it’s just a casual thing. Moving across the country? How are we supposed to just pick up from this? I mean, we’ve been through everything together, right? Do you know how much time we've spent planning, laughing, crying—literally making this a home? I'm trying to think of the bright side, I really am, but my mind's a mess. I don’t want to lose you to time zones and rare calls. We’ll figure something out, we have to, but right now, it’s just really hard to see how this even starts. You can’t just text me a shrug and think that's a goodbye. We need more than that. So much more.
